name: Gokase (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Gokase town emblem in white: a winged top above a ring, like a stylised numeral 5.
history: Municipal flag of Gokase, a town in Miyazaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 1961.

features.role: Gokase town emblem — a winged top above a ring, like a stylised numeral 5
